title: Did the energy go down?
story: The minimization finished. Its energies are in em.edr, a binary file you read with `gmx energy`. Pull out the potential energy into potential.xvg and type its average (in kJ/mol, as a whole number) in the answer box.

~/{{dir}}/em.edr.binary: GROMACS energy file (.edr). Read it with `gmx energy -f FILE`.

tasks.text: Write the potential energy to potential.xvg
What is the average potential energy?

hints: `gmx energy -f em.edr -o potential.xvg` asks which terms you want. Pipe the answer in: `echo Potential | gmx energy -f em.edr -o potential.xvg`.
The average is in the table at the end, in the Average column.
solution: echo Potential | gmx energy -f em.edr -o potential.xvg
